search_intent: RoRo versus container vehicle shipping Latin America buyer verification
buyer_task: Choose RoRo vs container for a specific LA route from actual port/carrier/route/vehicle-condition/hand-off evidence, not a regional average.
http_access_legend: ACCESSIBLE=reachable (HTTP 200/206) AND reopened/read this repair where FACT_VERIFIED=true; reachable alone never verifies a fact.
ACCESS_BLOCKED_403=403/WAF/human-check; recorded as access limitation, NOT dead.
CONNECTION_FAILED=DNS/reset; TIMEOUT=connect/SSL timeout; neither is DEAD.
MOVED_OR_REDIRECTED / REPLACED_BY_CURRENT_OFFICIAL_SOURCE / DEAD_CONFIRMED: none required this round (no URL was declared dead).
ACCESS_STATUS_UNKNOWN=not requested in either the 09-08 sweep or the 09-09 reopen; no accessibility claim made.

sources.title: International Chamber of Commerce
sources.facts_supported: Incoterms(r) 2020 Checklist: FAS/FOB maritime/inland-waterway only; FCA for any mode incl multimodal and terminal delivery; C-group (CFR/CIF/CPT/CIP) are shipment contracts - risk passes on delivery (on board) in seller's country while seller pays main carriage; under CIF seller must arrange minimum-cover cargo insurance (LMA/IUA Clauses C or similar), CIP requires all-risk cover (Clauses A).

sources.title: World Trade Organization
sources.facts_supported: WTO Agreement on Implementation of Article VII GATT (customs valuation); framework not re-read this session; proves no national rule.

sources.title: World Bank
sources.facts_supported: LPI 2.0 background not re-read; no country rule.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: SOLAS VGM requires verification of a packed container's gross mass (global framework) - relevant only to the container option and identifies no LA port.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Not reopened this session; global rule only.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: IMO Cargo Securing gives global cargo-securing framework; carrier- and port-specific securing instructions still govern a given sailing.
Incoterms 2020 distinguish maritime FOB/FAS from multimodal FCA/CIP and CIF minimum vs CIP all-risk insurance - informs handover/insurance framing only.
World Bank LPI is country logistics background and is not a sailing/port/acceptance source.

Record origin/destination ports, transshipment, operability, fuel/battery rules, securing, keys/condition record, insurance and destination release; obtain dated carrier/port confirmation (methodology).
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Procedural guidance, not an external factual assertion; requires no external source and must not be presented as a regulation.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: UNECE WP.29 vehicle-regulation framework is global and identifies no LA port/carrier.
UNCTAD Review of Maritime Transport is global shipping background, not a LA sailing/route source.
IDB is regional development-bank background and supplies no carrier acceptance or port rule.
WTO customs-valuation framework is global and does not establish LA RoRo/container acceptance.

writing_constraints: Do NOT state BLOCKED_FACTS as certainties; phrase as 'confirm with the named authority/carrier/OEM before purchase' or omit.
Every deterministic body claim must map to a FACT_VERIFIED=true matrix row; CONTEXT_ONLY global sources may frame but never prove a destination rule.
Preserve candidate URL/canonical and all 12 locales; Research changes facts boundaries only.
